title: Minimal-delta-V2 rank-lift (CeNGEN x_c) + SOL7 freeze-statistic harness (KEYSTONE)
gated_on: P18 PASS (V1 certified rank-2: QF = G(total_pa, snare_factor)); SOL7 WB0 (freeze spread statistic S in closed form) is a HARD PREDECESSOR of any Match#3 run.
premise: V1's anesthetic operator broadcasts a single scalar total_pa over ALL neurons (I_ext[:] += total_pa*pA) and a single global SNARE synaptic-gain scalar. The realized per-neuron input is therefore rank-2 in (total_pa, snare_factor): every neuron sees the same drive, so cell-type-targeting (Match#3) is mathematically entailed-by-construction and was NEVER actually tested (v7 left P8/Match#3 NOT_TESTED). P1_P2 lifts the operator rank by replacing the all-ones broadcast with CeNGEN per-class expression vectors x_c (7xN, one row per non-SNARE current class), so the per-neuron drive becomes I_ext += alpha * sum_c (-sat_c * e_c) * x_c, lifting rank 2 -> min(7,N). This makes Match#3 (cell-type spread of the conserved profile vs magnitude+SNARE-matched random ensembles) a GENUINE accept-either-way test for the first time.

non_destructive_contract.frozen_operator_untouched: phase_g_state_validator.apply_anesthetic and apply_genotype are NOT edited. The rank-lift is a NEW function apply_anesthetic_v2 (and a new genotype path if needed) in a NEW module src/state_validation/p1_p2_rank_lift.py.
non_destructive_contract.new_artifacts_only: All outputs under audits/phase2/P1_P2/ and artifacts/p1_p2/. No v7_* ensemble artifact is overwritten.
non_destructive_contract.bit_identity_regression: apply_anesthetic_v2 with x_c == ones(N) for every class MUST produce a per-neuron I_ext delta and snare_factor BIT-IDENTICAL (L_inf <= 1e-12 pA, exact for snare) to the frozen apply_anesthetic over a battery of >=12 (profile,dose) cases. This is gate G_BIT_IDENTITY and is HARD: fail => the new path is not a faithful superset of V1 and HALTS the block.

marker_genes_per_class_FROZEN.complex_i_block: x_c = ones by biology (mitochondrial Complex I / ATP coupling is ubiquitous; NOT a cell-type-resolved channel). Justification frozen: global metabolic class.
marker_genes_per_class_FROZEN.complex_ii_block: x_c = ones by biology (Complex II ubiquitous metabolic). Frozen global.

x_c_construction.snare_gating_FROZEN: SNARE (snare_cooperativity) remains a SYNAPTIC-gain channel (not I_ext). In V2 it is gated by PRESYNAPTIC unc-64 (syntaxin) expression on the source neuron of each synapse: per-edge factor = 1 + (snare_max-1)*e_snare*x_unc64[presyn]. With x_unc64 == ones this reduces EXACTLY to V1's global syn.w *= factor. unc-64 marker WBGene00006798 confirmed present in CSV.
x_c_construction.tpm_to_x_transform_FROZEN: Per class c, aggregate marker TPM per neuron i = MAX over the class's marker genes of class-mean TPM (max, not sum, to avoid gene-count bias). Then x_c[i] = clip(tpm_i / threshold_c, 0, 1) where threshold_c = the class's CeNGEN T-level expression threshold; FROZEN as threshold = the 75th percentile of nonzero class-mean TPM for that class's marker set (label-free, computed from the CSV BEFORE any sim, hash recorded in artifacts/p1_p2/x_c.json). Neurons whose CeNGEN class is absent from the CSV get x_c = 0 for that class (recorded in coverage). Rationale frozen: a soft [0,1] expression gate, monotone in TPM, identical procedure for all 5 resolved classes; the 2 metabolic classes are ones by the biology rule above.
x_c_construction.ones_fallback_forbidden_for_resolved: The 5 resolved channel classes MUST use the TPM-derived x_c (NOT ones); only complex_i/ii are ones-by-biology. This is what makes the rank-lift real (G0).

spread_statistic_SOL7_WB0_FROZEN.name: S = between-class variance fraction eta^2 of the realized per-neuron drive (label-free participation-ratio-equivalent).
spread_statistic_SOL7_WB0_FROZEN.closed_form: Let d_i = realized per-neuron I_ext delta (pA) under a profile at the anchor dose (the SUM over classes of alpha*(-sat_c*e_c)*x_c[i]). Partition neurons by CeNGEN class label k. eta^2 = SS_between / SS_total where SS_between = sum_k n_k*(mean_k(d) - mean(d))^2 and SS_total = sum_i (d_i - mean(d))^2. eta^2 in [0,1]: 0 = drive identical across cell types (V1 broadcast), ->1 = drive perfectly stratified by cell type. CLOSED FORM, computed from d alone, NO simulation. This is the LABEL-AWARE statistic for the able-to-fail screen and the spread-percentile gate. (NOTE: the Match#3 SPATIAL gate G1 below uses a LABEL-FREE participation ratio PR as its primary statistic per the roadmap SOL1 WB0; eta^2 is the SOL7 between-cell-type-variance-fraction harness statistic. BOTH are frozen here; distance-to-template variants are FORBIDDEN.)
spread_statistic_SOL7_WB0_FROZEN.participation_ratio_FROZEN: PR(d) = (sum_i |d_i|)^2 / (N * sum_i d_i^2), in (0,1]; PR=1 iff all |d_i| equal (V1 broadcast => PR=1 exactly), PR< 1 iff drive concentrated on a sub-population. Match#3 conserved statistic = PR of the conserved profile's per-neuron drive; percentile = fraction of magnitude+SNARE-matched random ensembles whose PR is LOWER (more concentrated) than conserved.
spread_statistic_SOL7_WB0_FROZEN.able_to_fail_screen_FROZEN: Pseudo-test proving S can both fire and not fire, BEFORE biology: (a) DISJOINT-SUPPORT profiles: two synthetic profiles whose nonzero x_c support is disjoint MUST give DIFFERENT eta^2 (and different PR) -> assert |eta2_A - eta2_B| > 1e-6. (b) IDENTICAL-SUPPORT profiles: two profiles with IDENTICAL x_c (e.g. both all-ones, i.e. V1) MUST give the SAME eta^2 (= 0) and SAME PR (= 1) -> assert eta2==0 within 1e-12 and PR==1 within 1e-12. Fail of either => the statistic is broken; HALT.

G_BIT_IDENTITY.rule: apply_anesthetic_v2 with ALL x_c forced to ones(N) reproduces frozen apply_anesthetic's per-neuron I_ext delta to L_inf <= 1e-12 pA AND snare synaptic factor to 1e-12, over >=12 (profile,dose) cases (conserved + >=10 random, SNARE-present and SNARE-absent, multiple doses).
G_BIT_IDENTITY.on_fail: HALT P1_P2; the new operator path is not a faithful superset of V1; the rank-lift cannot be trusted.

G0_RANK_LIFT_REALIZED.type: build-only, no heavy sim, FROZEN two-sided, gates G1
G0_RANK_LIFT_REALIZED.rule: Construct two DISTINCT random profiles A,B with EQUAL (total_pa, snare_gain) at the anchor dose (matched to 1e-6 relative via the corrected v7_match2b sampler), using the REAL TPM-derived x_c. Compute their per-neuron drive vectors q_A, q_B (the realized I_ext delta per neuron). PASS iff ||q_A - q_B||_2 > 1e-6 pA (the rank-lift produced distinct per-neuron drive for equal scalar coordinates => rank actually > 2). FAIL iff ||q_A - q_B||_2 <= 1e-6 (the lift bought nothing; still rank-2 => Match#3 remains entailed-by-construction and MUST NOT be reported as a real test).
G0_RANK_LIFT_REALIZED.on_fail: HALT: G1 is NOT evaluated; the V2 build did not lift rank; report 'rank-lift not realized', do not run the Match#3 ensemble.

G1_MATCH3_SPATIAL_SPECIAL.type: heavy (ensemble), FROZEN three-sided, gated on G0 PASS
G1_MATCH3_SPATIAL_SPECIAL.statistic: conserved-profile participation-ratio PR percentile = fraction of magnitude+SNARE-matched random ensembles whose per-neuron-drive PR is LOWER (more cell-type-concentrated) than the conserved profile's PR, per organism (worm 300, fly 2952; mouse EXCLUDED = random graph).
G1_MATCH3_SPATIAL_SPECIAL.decision_rule: PR_percentile in (1%, 10%] => PASS (first non-by-construction cell-type-targeting positive: the conserved multi-class identity concentrates drive on a cell-type sub-population more than magnitude-matched randoms). PR_percentile > 10% => NULL/DEFLATE (cell-type spread does NOT establish targeting beyond magnitude; ledger states 'V2 rank-lift does NOT establish cell-type specificity'). PR_percentile <= 1% => TOO_SPECIAL leak (suspect a construction artifact pinning the conserved profile; quarantine and audit x_c). Accept whichever lands.

G2_MATCH3_NOT_ENTAILED.rule: Var(PR over the magnitude+SNARE-matched random surrogates) > 1e-9 per organism. If the surrogate PR is (near-)constant then PR is pinned by the magnitude coordinates and G1's percentile is not an independent spatial test (entailed-by-magnitude). PASS = Var > 1e-9 (PR carries spatial information not fixed by total_pa+snare). FAIL = Var <= 1e-9 (demote G1 to entailed-by-magnitude).

G_SOL7_able_to_fail.type: build-only, FROZEN two-sided, HARD PREDECESSOR of any run
G_SOL7_able_to_fail.rule: The able_to_fail_screen above: disjoint-support => different (eta^2, PR); identical-support (V1 all-ones) => eta^2==0 and PR==1. PASS iff BOTH hold within tolerance. FAIL => the spread statistic is not live on this substrate; HALT (cannot run Match#3, would be can-only-succeed).

sol8_followon_FLAG.scope: Stream NeuroPAL (~815MB) + Atanas quiescence bouts; gate G1_neuropal_join_correctness (per-class Jaccard>=0.5 for >=5/7 classes; HARD, fail HALTS + re-freeze x_c), G2 quiescence-structure (Spearman(S_V2, natural-quiescence-drop) above gene-marginal-preserving structured null; one-directional), G3 bout-yield fork (n_worms>=6 full / 3-5 descriptive / <3 park-G2). heavy_run.what: Match#3 ensemble: per organism, draw N_ENS magnitude+SNARE-matched random profiles (reuse v7_match2b corrected sampler), compute per-neuron-drive PR for each + conserved, derive PR-percentile (G1) and Var(PR) (G2). NO LIF sim is strictly required for the PR statistic (drive is closed-form from x_c); the ensemble cost is the rejection sampling + (optionally) the confirmatory QF re-sim to tie PR-spread to a behavioral readout. The frozen design runs the closed-form PR percentile (fast) AND the confirmatory LIF QF ensemble (heavy) on worm(300)+fly(2952).
heavy_run.mouse_excluded: random graph (P3 territory) -> no CeNGEN identity to target.

anti_target_engineering: All gate thresholds, the spread statistic (eta^2 + PR), the x_c TPM->[0,1] transform, the marker-gene sets, and the SNARE unc-64 gating are FROZEN in THIS file BEFORE the module is implemented and BEFORE any run. G1 is three-sided (PASS/NULL/too-special) and accept-either-way; a worm NULL (connectome~shuffled prior) is explicitly acceptable and publishable as 'V2 does NOT establish cell-type specificity in worm'. The bit-identity gate guarantees V2 is a strict superset of V1, so no claim is changed by re-tuning.
